title: Tomb U-j: A Royal Burial of Dynasty 0 at Abydos
version: Before the Pyramids: The Origins of Egyptian Civilization, Oriental Institute Museum Publications 33, pp. 127–136

passages.note: Ceramic phase is Naqada IIIa2. The excavator dates the tomb about 150 years before the First Dynasty, whose beginning he places circa 3200–3150 BCE.
Reports incised bone and ivory tags with holes and separate ink-marked vessels. Reads several tag signs as phonetic and interprets the tags as labels.
